en.headline: Juvenile arrests up 20 percent in first half of 2026, police say
en.dek: Commissioner Joe Chow reported 1,580 young people aged 10 to 20 arrested from January to June, with sharp rises in serious assault and criminal damage cases linked to debt collection.
body: Hong Kong police arrested 1,580 people aged between 10 and 20 in the first half of 2026, a rise of about 20 percent year on year, Commissioner of Police Joe Chow said on Wednesday.

Serious assault and wounding cases accounted for 283 arrests, up nearly 50 percent. Criminal damage arrests rose by more than 50 percent to 140, many linked to debt-collection activities such as splashing red paint. Chow said many of the young people involved had been exploited and paid for tasks they did not fully understand as criminal.

About 70 percent of the assault cases were described as impulsive rather than premeditated, often arising from money or relationship disputes. Drug-related arrests totalled 285, including 92 involving etomidate.

Police released a new booklet aimed at parents and teachers to help identify early warning signs and intervene before young people become involved in common traps such as quick-money schemes, online grooming, violence and emerging drugs.

zh.headline: 上半年青少年被捕人數升兩成 警推刊物助師長預防
zh.dek: 警務處處長周一鳴表示，今年1至6月共拘捕1580名10至20歲青少年，較去年同期升約兩成，傷人及刑事毀壞案升幅顯著。
body: 警務處處長周一鳴周三表示，今年上半年警方共拘捕1580名10至20歲青少年，較去年同期上升約兩成。
其中傷人及嚴重毆打案有283人被捕，升近五成；刑事毀壞案有140人，升逾五成，當中不少與收數活動有關，例如淋紅油。周一鳴指，不少青少年被人利用，收取報酬後作出違法行為，自己未必清楚那是犯罪。
傷人案件中約七成屬一時衝動，多涉金錢或感情糾紛，並非有預謀。毒品相關案件共拘捕285人，當中92人涉依托咪酯。
警方同日推出新一期《師長攻略．青少年陷阱解密》刊物，涵蓋搵快錢、網上性誘識、暴力欺凌及新興毒品等議題，協助家長及教師及早識別及介入。
